meta.title: Dutch with "Offers on Total Amount" hides the closing condition

steps.note: Start the RFQ event that will be converted to a Dutch auction.
Create an RFQ-only project so it can be converted to an auction.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the required product line item.
Add the participant required for publishing.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the auction conversion create screen where Dutch auction options are configured.

args.goal: select the Dutch auction option, choose Offers on Total Amount, and verify that the closing-condition selector is not shown

steps.note: Perform the Dutch-specific configuration and directly verify the requested hidden control.
Confirm the configuration screen has no application error after the selection.
